label: Jesus' own speech: Speech: what Jesus himself actually said. trialSaid c: at the hearing before…
definition: `Speech`: what Jesus himself actually said. `trialSaid c`: at the hearing before the high priest Jesus himself said content c (Mark 14 content type); `assertedAuthority a`: Jesus himself asserted the authority content a (Mark 2 content type); `usedOfHimself h`: in asserting authority content about the holder title h, Jesus used the title of himself. Distinct from the narrative `attributes` fields, which record textual attribution only (DISAMB-MARK-HIGH-PRIEST-EXCHANGE, DISAMB-MARK-FORGIVENESS-AUTHORITY). Example: a saying a reliable witness heard him say; counterexample: a saying an evangelist composed and placed on his lips. No axiom links the fields to the reports; only the open report-to-event bridges do.
note: Analyst vocabulary (attribution deferred). A sourced definition is not needed: the term is the ordinary historical notion of an utterance by a person.
